name: Dependency change guard
summary: Keep dependency changes reproducible and block explicit package-manager safety bypasses.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for Bash, Write, and Edit that prevents direct lockfile editing, rejects narrow package-manager safety bypass flags, and verifies at commit time that changed dependency manifests have a staged associated lockfile when one exists.
risk_reason: This automatic gate keeps dependency changes reproducible and block explicit package-manager safety bypasses; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not install, remove, upgrade, resolve, audit, or choose a dependency for the user.
It does not claim that a matching manifest and lockfile diff proves dependency safety or build correctness.
It does not expose a project-writable policy, silently rewrite a lockfile, or approve a bypassing command.

entrypoints.purpose: Inspect bounded Git state and deterministically enforce reproducible dependency-change boundaries.

linkReasons.hook/security/application-security/shell: dependency-change-guard cannot see hidden commands (e.g. bash -c "$X"): shell-command-guard stops them.

operational.latency_reason: To keep dependency changes reproducible and block explicit package-manager safety bypasses, the entrypoint may run a bounded local subprocess before returning.
